description: Changes the settings of an automation set up from Cosend’s “Lead follow-up” recipe, named by id, as its settings page in Cosend does: the settings given replace their values, the rest keep theirs, and the result is saved as a new version. If the automation is switched on, the new settings go live with the save, or the save is refused in words and it keeps running what it ran; if it is off, they wait for it to be switched on. An automation from another recipe, or one written by hand, is refused. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the new version.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The automation set up from the “Lead follow-up” recipe whose settings change.

settings.description: The settings to change, as the recipe’s settings form asks them. A setting left out keeps the value it has.

fallback_language.description: Sent when the customer’s own language isn’t one of the message’s approved languages. Left empty, the message’s first approved language.
fallback_language.title: Fallback language

lead_ads.description: Your connected lead ads. Every new lead from their forms gets your message, as each form’s consent setting allows.
lead_ads.title: Lead forms

questions.description: When a lead replies, your AI receptionist asks these, one at a time, before it books or passes the chat to you.
questions.title: Questions for the AI receptionist

template.description: A message approved by WhatsApp, sent to each new lead within seconds. It fills in their name first.

components.text: Hi {{1}}, thank you for your request. Reply here with any question and we will help you right away.
